priorityList: Maintain Arcane Intellect and summon your Water Elemental before combat.
Use your Trinkets, Potion, and Racial abilities alongside Frozen Orb or Ray of Frost.
Cast Comet Storm if the Splinterstorm buff is not active.
Cast Blizzard whenever the Freezing Rain buff is active (procced by Frozen Orb).
Cast Ice Lance if you have Fingers of Frost procs.
Cast Glacial Spike whenever you have 5 Icicles.
Cast Ice Lance if the target has 6 or more stacks of the Freezing (Winter's Chill) debuff.
On 4 or more enemies, cast Ice Nova followed by Cone of Cold if talented into Cone of Frost.
Cast Blizzard as a high priority in AoE (3+ targets) even without Freezing Rain.
Cast Flurry if you have a Brain Freeze proc.
Cast Ray of Frost on cooldown.
Cast Flurry if you have charges available to apply Winter's Chill.
Cast Frostbolt as your main filler spell to generate Icicles and procs.
